cases.about: A scene-named film and a 1x02 episode get the exact moves for the person; the show with no poster and the two Alien files are listed; nothing is moved.

call.command: printf '%s\n' '/srv/media' | ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 -- nas 'IFS= read -r p; cd -- "$p" && find . -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname "*.mkv" -o -iname "*.mp4" -o -iname "*.avi" -o -iname "poster.*" -o -iname "folder.*" \) | sort' 2>&1

script.say:
**Misnamed**

- Shows/Bluey/Season 01/bluey 1x02.mkv — not "Show - SNNENN" — `mv -n -- 'Shows/Bluey/Season 01/bluey 1x02.mkv' 'Shows/Bluey/Season 01/Bluey - S01E02.mkv'`

- Shows/Bluey — no poster (the server may fetch one)

**Duplicates**
- Films/Alien (1979)/Alien (1979).mkv and Films/Alien (1979)/Alien (1979) [copy].mkv
